method: LATEST task b18-discretes, 23 Nov 2026 - all 36 lines worked, all 36 priced from the Digi-Key product page for the exact orderable code (evidence page-read; visible price tables only - no search-summary figure, no hidden page data). Codes: 22 lines carried the exact code; 10 lines gave a type number without the packing suffix and were resolved on Digi-Key (Diodes BAT54SQ-7-F, DESD1CAN2SOQ-7, DESD1CANFD24VSOQ-7, DESD1LIN2WSQ-7, SBR3U40P1Q-7; Nexperia 2N7002AK-QR, BAS21-QR, BAV99-QR, BC807-40-QR, BC817-40-QR - the -QR reel code); 3 were SERIES lines given a 24 V unidirectional representative (SMAJ24AQ-13-F, SMBJ24AQ-13-F, SZSMF6L24AT3G - reason in notes); 1 line had a WRONG CODE (AB-PL1515C0I6-5VX01515 does not exist; the real part AB-PL1515C0I6-5VX0 is priced). Per part from the Digi-Key page: the cut-tape row nearest 1,000 (Diodes Inc. tables stop at 100, Nexperia -QR at 500 or 1,000, the SZSMF6L at 500, CAN0001DP at 500 with the 1,000 break on the reel table; the others reach 1,000) and the smallest and largest Tape & Reel rows. Cut tape and Digi-Reel are one table on most pages (recorded as cut tape); where they are separate tables (V18MLA0805NHAUTO, ASMDC030F-2) only the Cut Tape table is recorded. Largest published break: 30,000 (two Nexperia transistors), 25,000 (one varistor), 21,000 / 14,000 (the LEDs), otherwise 4,000-15,000 - NOTHING near 200,000 is published for any of these codes. 35 parts have two rows of the SAME full packaging (own reel slope); ASMDC030F-2 has a single reel row. Grade: 34 codes carry Grade 'Automotive' + Qualification AEC-Q101 / AEC-Q102 / AEC-Q200 on the Digi-Key product page (this confirms the 11 Littelfuse / KYOCERA AVX lines the task had as aecq false); AB-PL1515C0I6-5VX0 rests on Digi-Key's series highlight page (no field on the product page); BSS123W-7-F shows no grade field - aecq false. No part is obsolete / NRND; 12 are out of stock at Digi-Key with a normal table (7 Diodes Inc., all 5 Nexperia -QR codes). Cross-checks: Master Electronics lists none of these makers' codes (3 reads: 'no exact match' for 2N7002Q-7-F, 'no search results' for MINIASMDC050F-2 and CAN0001DP - stopped). TME (USD, net = gross, 2 decimals, one page a minute, 8 requests - the task limit): 6 product pages served and recorded (V18MLA0603NHAUTO, V18MLA0805NHAUTO, SBR3U40P1Q-7, DESD1CAN2SOQ-7, SMAJ24AQ-13-F, SMBJ24AQ-13-F - chosen because their prices keep two significant figures at 2 decimals; the 2-7 cent SOT-23 parts would round to one figure and were not read), 1 guessed URL 404 and 1 search page without a product row (MINIASMDC050F-2). Digi-Key is 1.05-1.53x TME at the same reel break on those six; no pair exceeds 2.5x. Mouser, Arrow, Farnell, Avnet, Newark, RS, Rutronik, Future and LCSC were not tried: each refused or served no data in every earlier run today. Pacing: one page at a time, 20 s before every Digi-Key / Master read, about a minute between TME pages. Budget used: 1 web search (the SZSMF6L product URL - no price taken from it), 52 page requests: Digi-Key 41 (all served: 36 product pages, 2 result lists for ASMDC050F-2 / ASMDC030F-2 that needed a second read, 1 'no results' page for the wrong AB-PL code, 1 product-highlight page, 1 re-read of the V18MLA0805NHAUTO pricing section), Master Electronics 3, TME 8. Digi-Key did not refuse. Digi-Key observation URLs are the keyword URL that landed on the product page, or the product detail URL where one was read.
